## Change logs

## New Commands
- `billing focus-report` adds a billing report in the [FOCUS format](https://focus.finops.org/)

## Commands Changed
- `iam account-settings` displays Account Invite Domain information
- `iam account-settings-update` adds `--restrict-user-invitations-domains`, `--restrict-user-invitations-realm`, `--restrict-user-list-visibility`, and `--unset-restrict-user-invitations` to manage the Account Invite Domain settings

## Bug Fixes
- Windows version displays commands in help messages without the path

## Other Changes
- Golang version 1.27.3
- IBM Cloud SDK version 1.14.1
- IBM Cloud Dev plug-in version 3.5.10 (for open source vulnerability updates)
